title: Import wizard refuses a required field left unmapped even when the field has a defaultValue (18.2 regression from 17.2): "required field(s) not mapped"
body:
Filed by the objectstack-ai/duly lane seat from a browser measurement on duly (objectstack-ai/duly#128, PR objectstack-ai/duly#161). For central triage; no `domain:*` label is set here.

## What happens (@objectstack 18.2.0, Console Import)

1. In the duly demo, open Duty list → Import.
2. Upload `samples/duties.csv` as it is on duly `main` before PR #161. The file has no `review_status` column.
3. The mapping step shows **"Can't continue — required field(s) not mapped: Review status (review_status)"**, and Next is disabled.

`duly_duty.review_status` is `required: true` but carries a record-derived `defaultValue` (CEL: `record.source == 'self' ? 'to_review' : 'to_confirm'`), so a row without the column is valid on the write path. The same file imported 19 rows on @objectstack 17.2.0.

## Expected

The mapping step treats a required field that has a `defaultValue` (static or expression) as satisfied when it is unmapped, and leaves the value to the write path, which already applies the default. A required field with no default still blocks.

## App workaround

duly PR #161 adds an explicit `review_status` column to the sample, with the values the default would compute. A customer's own spreadsheet will not carry that column.

Dedupe words: import wizard required defaultValue, required field not mapped, mapping step blocks defaulted field.
